summary: Hand-wrote the reader-facing console pages for the ntuple-rl family: the family page approaches/ntuple-rl/README.mdx (what an n-tuple network is, what learning from play means here, and the family's honest shared outcome) and all twelve approach pages — bellman-ntuple, curriculum-option-ppo, manifold-ppo, native-ppo, native-suite, optimistic-phase, phase-blend, primal-dual-actor-critic, rainbow-q, regenerative-expert-iteration, temporal-coherence, and torch-ppo. Every page follows the four-altitude template and quotes only figures that exist in a retained record, carrying its evidence label; pages for task-record-only experiments state plainly that no result was retained. Each page carries the scoring-mode caveat that applies to its numbers, sourced from the ledger and from docs/exploratory/audit-03-claim-arithmetic.md. No research record, protocol, or source file was changed and no experiment was run.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
